q: How many faculty are in the Engineering department?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Engineering'

q: How many faculty hold the Lecturer rank?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE academic_rank='Lecturer'

q: How many departments are there?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departments

q: What is the average age of faculty?
truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age)::numeric,1) FROM faculty_development

q: How many faculty in the Medicine department are from Deemed universities?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Medicine' AND university_type='Deemed'

q: What is the average AI tool adoption score for Professors?
truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(ai_tool_adoption_score)::numeric,1) FROM faculty_development WHERE academic_rank='Professor'

q: What is the highest number of research publications by any one person?
truth_sql: SELECT MAX(research_publications) FROM faculty_development

q: What is the average number of publications per faculty member?
truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(research_publications)::numeric,2) FROM faculty_development

q: Which has more faculty, Computer Science or Management?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Computer Science'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Management'

q: How many faculty in the Engineering department are not Professors?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Engineering' AND academic_rank<>'Professor'

q: How many faculty are in either the Engineering or the Medicine department?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department IN ('Engineering','Medicine')

q: How many female faculty are in the Engineering department?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Engineering' AND gender='Female'

q: How many faculty in the Engineering department are older than 50?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Engineering' AND age>50

q: Which department has the most faculty?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Engineering'

q: How many Expert-level faculty are in Computer Science?
truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_development WHERE department='Computer Science' AND competency_level='Expert'

q: What is the maximum number of training programs attended by any faculty member?
truth_sql: SELECT MAX(training_programs_attended) FROM faculty_development
